- Which New York airport (and which West Coast destination city/airport)

- Cabin class (basic economy, economy, or business)
- Passenger names and dates of birth
- Whether you'd like travel insurance ($30 per passenger)
- Which payment method from your profile to use (you have gift_card_7359776 at $39 and gift_card_7773485 at $203)

How would you like to proceed — replace Ethan with another traveler, or be transferred to a human agent about the cancellation?
